draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.32, the 51st-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 6th of 29 at CB. He went 73rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Jaylen Watson. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (5th percentile). College production: 4 passes defended in 2024, 18th of 29 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the New York Jets. 12 career games and 5 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: completion % allowed 48.1% (96th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 cornerback who played: 27.6% season snap share against a median of 27.6% (level with).
